mission.title: Попередження Петрові
mission.mission_role: parallel-witness investigation / prediction evidence / delayed retrieval
learning_objectives: Extract the narrow shared prediction without false harmonization.
Expose Mark rooster-count TX1 before affected grading and preserve translation neutrality.
Create concrete prediction→fulfilment retrieval into LN-09.
mission.future_repetition_hooks: All node hooks are materialized as RESOLVED_NODE / REVIEW_QUEUE / DEFERRED_CAMPAIGN / RETIRED in node records.
mission.source_classification_notes: Local witness claims are T1; direct cross-witness comparison is T2; exact merged chronology is D1. TX1 is adjunct only.
disputed_points: Exact inter-Gospel micro-order is not forced.
Luke pronoun-number observation does not authorize a wider doctrinal conclusion.
textual_variant_points: Mark 14:30 rooster-count wording: TX1; responsible textual/translation forms are not penalized.
mission.opening_brief: Investigate Peter's prediction witness-by-witness before fulfilment is opened.
mission.case_question: What did Jesus predict to Peter, what did Peter claim, and which details are shared versus witness-specific?
known_facts_at_start: Prediction occurs before fulfilment material used in LN-09.
Player already knows shared-core versus witness-specific discipline.
mission.completion_synthesis: The prediction is reconstructed with witness provenance, explicit uncertainty and a concrete retrieval chain into LN-09.
mission.failure_recovery_routes: Every partial/incorrect branch is explicit per node and returns to a valid remediation/current node or advances after guided resolution; no dead ends.
mission.completion_conditions: Complete 13 required nodes through independent or guided routes; preserve source/provenance/confidence/TX1 boundaries; all remediation routes must remain reachable.
mission.perfect_investigation_conditions: Independent completion of high-value recall/application/synthesis nodes plus optional evidence where offered; knowledge-performance only, never spiritual status.

accessibility.screen_reader_announcement_requirements: Announce node identity, source scope, result, evidence/confidence/TX1 qualification, mastery consequence, and next action.
accessibility.nonvisual_equivalent: Sequential witness blocks, labelled fields, keyboard ordering/matching alternatives and plain-text TX1 notes.
accessibility.focus_order: Logical document/task order; after source inspection or feedback focus returns to the task heading/control.
